hints.content:
We are given that the chess club accepts $\green{5}$ new members each week.

The table of values for the ballet club shows that for each increase of $\blue{7}$ weeks of $\blue{\text{Time}}$, $\pink{\text{Members}}$ increases by $\pink{42}$. The number of new members each week is the ratio of the corresponding differences in $\pink{\text{Members}}$ and $\blue{\text{Time}}$:

$\qquad\dfrac{\Delta \pink{\text{Members}}}{\Delta \blue{\text{Time}}}=\dfrac{42}{7}=\green{6}$

This means that the ballet club accepts $\green{6}$ new members each week.

**Since $\green{5}<\green{6}$, the ballet club accepts more new members each week.**

We are given that the chess club had $37$ members after $6$ weeks. Since they accept $\green{5}$ new members each week, they accepted $6\cdot\green{5}=30$ new members since the club was founded. $37-30=\pink{7}$, so the chess club had $\pink{7}$ founding members.

We can extend the table of the ballet club according to the rate of change we found to find the value of $\pink{\text{Members}}$ when $\blue{\text{Time}}$ was $\blue 0$ weeks:

Time | Members
-:|-: 
$0$ | $10$
$-1\uparrow$ | $-6\uparrow$
$1$ | $16$
$-1\uparrow$ | $-6\uparrow$
$2$ | $22$
$-1\uparrow$ | $-6\uparrow$
$3$ | $28$

This means that the ballet club had $\pink{10}$ founding members.

**Since $\pink{7}<\pink{10}$, the ballet club had more founding members.**

Let's sum it up:

- The ballet club accepts more new members each week.

- The ballet club had more founding members.

question.content:
The chess club and the ballet club of Nahk University were founded at the same time, and they each accept new members at a constant rate.

The chess club accepts $5$ new members each week, and it had $37$ members after $6$ weeks.

The number of members in the ballet club as a function of time (in weeks) is given by the following table of values:

$\text{Time}$ (weeks) | $\text{Members}$
:-: | :-:
$3$ | $28$
$10$ | $70$
$17$ | $112$

**Which club accepts more members each week?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

**Which club had more founding members?**

[[☃ radio 2]]

choices.content: They both accept the same number of new members each week
They both had the same number of founding members
